projectDescription: Fintheon is an integrated desktop trading environment for futures that combines real-time AI-scored news, multi-agent deliberation, CAO chat, and execution tooling into a single workspace.
keyFeatures: CAO Chat (Harper) — AI chief analyst with streaming multi-turn conversation and multi-agent boardroom dispatch
Arbitrum — 5-seat AI deliberation engine producing consensus probability, confidence, and dissent digest
RiskFlow — real-time scored news feed with IV-weighted urgency and watchlist filtering
Sanctum — composite timeline + Aquarium + NarrativeFlow workspace for narrative-driven analysis
Daily Briefs (MDB / ADB / PMDB / TWT) — scheduled AI-generated market briefings
PsychAssist — trader tilt and emotional-risk detection via ER scoring
Consilium — multi-agent team boardroom with DAG orchestration and live agent presence
Trading Journal — session PnL tracking, performance charting, and catalyst review
Voice Mode — voice-to-text and AI voice responses via VoiceRimFrame
CLI — install, update, start, stop, and manage the platform from the terminal
